summary: A town drops a plan to abolish its police department a week after voting for it, as recall petitions start.
realLife: A town deep in debt from a wastewater plant voted to dissolve its police department to cut costs. A week later, after angry residents, recall petitions and a sheriff who said no handover was ready, it voted to fund police for the next year. Residents said the first vote was taken without comment on that motion. The vice mayor, who voted to dissolve after being fired from the department, faced an investigation.
sources: Fox News (Purcellville, Virginia), 'Virginia town backs away from dissolving police department after citizen uproar', April 23, 2025: https://www.foxnews.com/us/virginia-town-backs-away-from-dissolving-police-department-after-citizen-uproar.amp
